title: Goodman keeps him on salary during illness
summary: Benny paid $75 a week for a year; the cheap rented house.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: When you got TB, did Benny keep you on salary all the time you were recovering?
How long were you on that?
They first time was a year. I got seventy five bucks a week for

a year. More important was the gesture, and in those days you could live on it. We had a wonderful house, that one back there; it was when Rockland County was rural and it was a Revolutionary War house; it was charming. It's no longer that way. Fifty seven bucks a month we paid.
